sentences.en: From The New York Times, this is The Interview.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，这里是《访谈》。

sentences.en: I'm Lulu Garcia Navarro.
sentences.zh: 我是露露·加西亚-纳瓦罗。

sentences.en: It has been, no exaggeration, one of the most consequential and dizzying periods in modern American politics.
sentences.zh: 毫不夸张地说，这是现代美国政治中最具决定性、最令人眩晕的时期之一。

sentences.en: It began with President Biden's disastrous debate, then came an assassination attempt against former President Trump.
sentences.zh: 这一切始于拜登总统灾难性的辩论，接着是对前总统特朗普的暗杀未遂。

sentences.en: A week later, President Biden dropped out of the race and endorsed his vice president, Kamala Harris.
sentences.zh: 一周后，拜登总统宣布退选，并支持他的副总统卡玛拉·哈里斯。

sentences.en: And now, Harris is the de facto Democratic nominee.
sentences.zh: 而现在，哈里斯已经成为事实上的民主党总统候选人。

sentences.en: At warp speed, the dynamics of this entire election have changed.
sentences.zh: 以极快的速度，整场选举的动态发生了改变。

sentences.en: Not just for voters, but for party leaders like Pete Buttigieg, who went from being a top Biden surrogate to a top Harris surrogate in hours.
sentences.zh: 不仅对选民如此，对皮条客这样的党内领袖也是如此，比如皮特·布蒂吉格，他在几小时内就从拜登的核心代言人变成了哈里斯的核心代言人。

sentences.en: Buttigieg is one of the most popular figures in the Democratic Party.
sentences.zh: 布蒂吉格是民主党内最受欢迎的人物之一。

sentences.en: Nicknamed Mayor Pete, he shot into the limelight when he ran for president in 2020 as the mayor of South Bend, Indiana.
sentences.zh: 他被昵称为“皮特市长”，在2000年以印第安纳州南本德市长身份竞选总统时一举成名。

sentences.en: He then joined the Biden administration as Secretary of Transportation.
sentences.zh: 随后他加入拜登政府担任交通部长。

sentences.en: But he's also frequently on TV as one of the Democrats' top messengers.
sentences.zh: 但他同时也经常出现在电视上，是民主党最重要的发言人之一。

sentences.en: Reportedly, he's under consideration to become Harris's running mate.
sentences.zh: 据报道，他正在被考虑成为哈里斯的竞选搭档。

sentences.en: If it happened, and they won, he'd be the first openly gay VP.
sentences.zh: 如果真的发生且他们赢了，他将成为第一位公开出柜的副总统。

sentences.en: On Thursday, I sat down with Buttigieg to talk about how Biden's decision to drop out changed the race, what took so long, and what's next.
sentences.zh: 周四，我与布蒂吉格坐下来交谈，讨论了拜登退选的决定如何改变了选情、为什么花了这么长时间，以及下一步会怎样。

sentences.en: And if you notice that I'm not calling him Secretary Buttigieg or asking anything about his work in the cabinet,
sentences.zh: 如果你注意到我没有叫他“布蒂吉格部长”，也没有询问任何关于他在内阁工作的问题，

sentences.en: it's because there's a law, the Hatch Act, that prevents him from mixing his day job with campaigning.
sentences.zh: 那是因为有一项法律，即《哈奇法案》，禁止他将日常工作与竞选活动混为一谈。

sentences.en: Here's my conversation with Pete Buttigieg.
sentences.zh: 以下是我与皮特·布蒂吉格的对话。

sentences.en: This has been a shocker of a week.
sentences.zh: 这真是令人震惊的一周。

sentences.en: And now Democrats find themselves having to kind of build the plane while they're flying it.
sentences.zh: 现在民主党人发现自己不得不在飞行中组装飞机。

sentences.en: They're sort of redefining the race.
sentences.zh: 他们正在某种程度上重新定义这场竞选。

sentences.en: They're having to introduce a new candidate.
sentences.zh: 他们不得不推出一位新候选人。

sentences.en: They're building momentum in the electorate.
sentences.zh: 他们正在选民中积聚势头。

sentences.en: What have you found most surprising as you've been out campaigning for Vice President Harris?
sentences.zh: 在为副总统哈里斯助选的过程中，你发现最让人惊讶的是什么？

sentences.en: Well, yeah, we've certainly had one surprise after another these last few weeks.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的，过去几周我们确实经历了一个又一个惊喜。

sentences.en: But what's been really interesting is to watch how she has built her campaign so quickly.
sentences.zh: 但真正有趣的是，看着她以如此之快的速度建立起她的竞选团队。

sentences.en: Now, of course, part of that is that she was already part of the ticket.
sentences.zh: 当然，部分原因在于她本来就是候选人之一。

sentences.en: She's already part of this administration.
sentences.zh: 她已经是本届政府的一部分。

sentences.en: The overall values are the same.
sentences.zh: 整体价值观是一样的。

sentences.en: The themes are the same.
sentences.zh: 主题也是一样的。

sentences.en: And yet, she did a lot more than just create a campaign organization or rebrand a campaign organization in a day or two.
sentences.zh: 然而，她做的事情远不止在一两天内组建一个竞选组织或重塑一个竞选组织。

sentences.en: You see her sounding themes that are distinctively hers.
sentences.zh: 你看到她表达了鲜明属于她自己的主题。

sentences.en: And I think seeing that happen so quickly has been really impressive.
sentences.zh: 我认为看到这一切发生得如此之快，真的让人印象深刻。

sentences.en: And it is remarkable that there's been this sudden vibe shift, if you will, in the Democratic Party since Biden dropped out.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，自从拜登退选以来，民主党内出现了一种突如其来的氛围转变，如果你愿意这么说的话。

sentences.en: What do you ascribe that level of enthusiasm to?
sentences.zh: 你将这种热情归因于什么？

sentences.en: Well, I think they're excited about what she represents as a messenger.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为他们对她作为传话人所代表的形象感到兴奋。

sentences.en: And it's been exciting to have a new focus on the things that we care about.
sentences.zh: 而且，能够将新的焦点放在我们关心的事情上，让人感到振奋。

sentences.en: Part of what President Biden did with his very just extraordinary historic selfless choice was he tore down some obstacles that stood between voters and the media and commentators and all of us.
sentences.zh: 拜登总统以其非常卓越、历史性且无私的选择所做的事情之一，就是打破了一些横亘在选民与媒体、评论员以及我们所有人之间的障碍。

sentences.en: And focusing on a lot of the issues and the values that I think can propel Democrats to victory.
sentences.zh: 并且专注于许多我认为能够推动民主党走向胜利的议题和价值观。

sentences.en: And what I mean by that is all the things that the election is really about.
sentences.zh: 我这么说是指这场选举真正关心的所有事情。

sentences.en: The chance to have an election that is not just about two candidates but is about us and how the choices that are going to be made by the next president affect our lives.
sentences.zh: 获得这样一次选举的机会：它不只是关于两个候选人，而是关于我们，以及下一位总统做出的选择将如何影响我们的生活。

sentences.en: That's something that is coming through with a new clarity right now.
sentences.zh: 这正是目前以一种崭新的清晰度展现出来的事情。

sentences.en: And as you described, vibe shift is really extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 正如你所描述的，这种氛围的转变确实非同寻常。

sentences.en: There's been kind of a level of joy to the campaign that I think is welcome.
sentences.zh: 这场竞选带有一种受欢迎的喜悦感，我认为这很好。

sentences.en: Not that it won't have incredibly tough moments in the weeks ahead, I'm sure.
sentences.zh: 当然，这并不是说在接下来的几周里不会经历极其艰难的时刻。

sentences.en: But it's become yet another point of contrast, I think, between our ticket and the Republican ticket,
sentences.zh: 但它成为了我们阵营与共和党阵营之间的又一个对比点，我认为，

sentences.en: which seems to really lean into this deathmatch conception of what politics is.
sentences.zh: 共和党似乎真的倾向于这种将政治视为生死决斗的概念。

sentences.en: Tear down obstacles.
sentences.zh: 打破障碍。

sentences.en: I mean, the obstacle, many would say, was President Biden himself to this moment.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，许多人会说，障碍本身就是拜登总统本人。

sentences.en: A New Times poll shows that over 80 percent of voters are happy that Biden dropped out.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的一项民意调查显示，超过80%的选民对拜登退选感到高兴。

sentences.en: Clearly voters were hungering for something different.
sentences.zh: 很明显，选民渴望有所不同。

sentences.en: I mean, why did the party ignore that desire for change for so long?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，为什么党内对这种变革渴望忽视了这么久？

sentences.en: Well, I think this is something the party was wrestling with for a long time.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为这是党内长期在纠结的事情。

sentences.en: And then the president wrestled with it personally.
sentences.zh: 然后总统本人也进行了内心挣扎。

sentences.en: And then he did something that is, it is world historically rare for not just the leader of a country but the most powerful person in the world to lay power aside.
sentences.zh: 接着他做了一件在世界历史上极其罕见的事：不仅是一个国家的领导人，而且是世界上最有权势的人，选择放下权力。

sentences.en: And it was really moving to watch in his speech the way he explained his thinking and said that this is not about me, it's about you.
sentences.zh: 看着他在演讲中阐述自己的想法，并说这不是为了我，而是为了你们，这真的很感人。

sentences.en: But at the same time, I also think his choice consolidated his standing, his presidency, and his legacy in a way that makes me proud of him.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，我也认为他的选择以一种让我为他感到骄傲的方式巩固了他的地位、他的总统任期和他的政治遗产。

sentences.en: I want to talk about that decision, but I first want to just ask you about how the decision came about.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈那个决定，但我首先想问你这个决定是如何做出的。

sentences.en: Because, you know, CNN reported that there haven't been any full cabinet meetings since late last year.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道的，美国有线电视新闻网报道说，自去年年底以来就没有召开过全体内阁会议。

sentences.en: And so I don't know how often you were meeting with President Biden himself, but as a surrogate, did you not have any questions or doubts about his abilities?
sentences.zh: 所以我不知道你和拜登总统本人会面有多频繁，但作为一个代言人，你难道对他的能力没有过任何疑问或怀疑吗？

sentences.en: You know, last time I was working with President Biden really closely was during a disaster a few months ago.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我上一次与拜登总统密切合作是在几个月前的一次灾难期间。

sentences.en: I'm reminding myself I'm not supposed to appear in my official capacity, so I won't delve into that.
sentences.zh: 我提醒自己我不应该以官方身份出现，所以我不会深入探讨那个问题。

sentences.en: But look, nobody's denying that he's 10 years older than he was 10 years ago.
sentences.zh: 但是听着，没有人否认他比10年前老了10岁。

sentences.en: And unlike what you see in the Trump personality cult, we're not going around saying that he leaps tall buildings in a single bound and as strong as an ox.
sentences.zh: 而且与你在特朗普个人崇拜中看到的不同，我们不会到处说他能飞檐走壁、力大无穷。

sentences.en: The point is that he's really good at being president.
sentences.zh: 关键在于他非常擅长当总统。

sentences.en: And in my view, still is.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，现在依然如此。

sentences.en: Hearing you, you have framed it as he sacrificed for his country, that this was a noble act.
sentences.zh: 听你这么说，你把它描述为他为国家做出了牺牲，这是一个高尚的举动。

sentences.en: But the reality was that he was facing sliding polling numbers.
sentences.zh: 但现实情况是，他面临着不断下滑的民调支持率。

sentences.en: He saw defection of donors and members of his party.
sentences.zh: 他看到了金主和党内成员的背离。

sentences.en: He could have made that choice weeks ago, giving Vice President Harris or any eventual nominee a much longer runway and time to defeat Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 他本可以在几周前做出这个选择，给副总统哈里斯或任何最终的候选人留出更充裕的时间和跑道来击败唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: And he didn't do it.
sentences.zh: 而他没有这样做。

sentences.en: Did he wait too long?
sentences.zh: 他是不是等得太久了？

sentences.en: One of the things you sign up for when you go into politics and certainly when you're in high office is everybody else telling you what you should have done.
sentences.zh: 当你涉足政坛，尤其是当你担任要职时，你必然会面临的一件事就是每个人都在告诉你你应该怎么做。

sentences.en: And we can all say he should have done this or he should have done the same thing but a different time or should have done it in a different way.
sentences.zh: 我们都可以说他本该这样做，或者他本该做同样的事但换个时间，或者本该用不同的方式去做。

sentences.en: But the fact stands that he did an extraordinary thing, in my view, a selfless thing and, in my view, the right thing.
sentences.zh: 但事实依然是，他做了一件非凡的事，在我看来是一件无私的事，而且在我看来是正确的事。

sentences.en: You know, we in the media were raising legitimate questions about Biden's age and his ability to run.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们媒体曾对拜登的年龄以及他竞选的能力提出过合理的质疑。

sentences.en: And yet, reporters were being excoriated by the campaign for asking those questions and by Biden in public.
sentences.zh: 然而，记者们却因为提出这些问题而遭到竞选团队的抨击，拜登本人也在公开场合抨击他们。

sentences.en: How do those attacks on the press sit with you, now knowing what we know?
sentences.zh: 结合我们现在所了解的情况，你对这些针对媒体的攻击作何感想？

sentences.en: Well, look, I've never participated in an attack on the press.
sentences.zh: 嗯，听着，我从来没有参与过对媒体的攻击。

sentences.en: I think that it is natural to feel strong, passionate, defensive even, about the person you believe in when you feel like they're being attacked,
sentences.zh: 我认为，当你觉得你所信仰的人受到攻击时，感到强烈、充满激情甚至具有防御心理是人之常情，

sentences.en: especially when you feel like they're being attacked unfairly.
sentences.zh: 特别是当你觉得他们受到不公正攻击的时候。

sentences.en: And there were a lot of moments where there was a sense—
sentences.zh: 而且有很多时刻，有一种感觉——

sentences.en: Well, certain dimensions, I think, were unfair.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为某些方面确实是不公正的。

sentences.en: For example, the fact that in a given day, you might have almost identical flubbing of names by the two major candidates,
sentences.zh: 例如，在某一天，两位主要候选人可能会犯下几乎完全相同的口误，

sentences.en: but only one of them would have that be kind of plastered in certain people's commentary.
sentences.zh: 但只有其中一个人的口误会被大肆渲染在某些人的评论中。

sentences.en: So there was a sense—and look, again, it's the nature of being passionate about the person you believe in to come to their defense.
sentences.zh: 所以有一种感觉——听着，再次强调，为你所信仰的人挺身而出、充满激情是这种热忱的本质。

sentences.en: But at the end of the day, what happened was one of the most extraordinary and rare things ever.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，发生的事情是历史上最非凡、最罕见的事件之一。

sentences.en: And look, I say this as somebody who has—I have launched campaigns.
sentences.zh: 而且听着，我是以一个曾经——我发起过竞选活动的人的身份说这番话的。

sentences.en: I know what it's like to end a campaign.
sentences.zh: 我知道结束一场竞选是什么感觉。

sentences.en: And I also know that he did what he feels like is the right thing and what I think is a decision that will allow him to concentrate on the presidency and allow the campaign and the party to concentrate on the campaign.
sentences.zh: 我也知道他做了他认为正确的事情，并且我认为这个决定将使他能够专注于总统职务，并让竞选团队和党派能够专注于竞选工作。

sentences.en: We've seen just Democrats rallying around the VP.
sentences.zh: 我们已经看到民主党人纷纷团结在副总统周围。

sentences.en: And we started this conversation by talking about how quickly everything has coalesced.
sentences.zh: 我们在对话开始时就讨论过一切凝聚得有多快。

sentences.en: There was a lot of discussion in the weeks after Biden's disappointing debate about what another nomination process could look like.
sentences.zh: 在拜登令人失望的辩论之后的几周里，关于另一种提名程序可能会是什么样子的讨论有很多。

sentences.en: And at the end, it just doesn't seem like there has been any appetite for an open convention, a more competitive process among Democrats.
sentences.zh: 但最后，民主党人似乎对开放式全国代表大会或更具竞争性的程序没有任何热情。

sentences.en: Why do you think that is?
sentences.zh: 你认为这是为什么？

sentences.en: I think a lot of people looked at her, looked at what she brought, looked at the importance of quickly bringing the party together,
sentences.zh: 我认为很多人看着她，看着她带来的东西，看着迅速团结党派的重要性，

sentences.en: and reached that conclusion that backing her was the best way to do that.
sentences.zh: 并得出了这样的结论：支持她是做到这一点的最好方法。

sentences.en: And again, I know a little bit about this.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，我对这方面略知一二。

sentences.en: I remember making the toughest decision of my personal political career, which was the decision to end my presidential campaign,
sentences.zh: 我记得我做出了个人政治生涯中最艰难的决定，那就是决定结束我的总统竞选，

sentences.en: and realizing that even though I wasn't a candidate anymore, what I did mattered, and I had a responsibility to try to do what I could to lead to a good outcome.
sentences.zh: 并意识到尽管我不再是候选人了，但我所做的事情依然重要，我负有责任去尽我所能促成一个好的结果。

sentences.en: And that led me to decide very quickly to back President Biden's campaign.
sentences.zh: 这促使我非常迅速地决定支持拜登总统的竞选。

sentences.en: And this felt like a similar moment where, you know, whether it was by dint of being in office or just being somebody with a platform,
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是一个相似的时刻，你知道，无论是由于身居要职还是仅仅作为一个拥有发声平台的人，

sentences.en: there were a lot of people who had a lot of influence and therefore a lot of responsibility.
sentences.zh: 有很多人拥有很大的影响力，因此也负有重大的责任。

sentences.en: And just about everybody decided the best way to use that influence and responsibility was to help bring the party together quickly.
sentences.zh: 几乎所有人都决定，利用这种影响力和责任的最佳方式是帮助党派迅速团结起来。

sentences.en: I mean, it's good politics.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是明智的政治策略。

sentences.en: Do you think people actually came to these conclusions individually?
sentences.zh: 你认为人们真的是各自独立得出这些结论的吗？

sentences.en: Or was there a sense from the party leadership that everyone needed to fall in line?
sentences.zh: 还是说党内领导层传达了一种每个人都需要服从大局的意识？

sentences.en: Well, Democrats are not exactly famous for falling in line when we do something like coalesce that quickly.
sentences.zh: 嗯，民主党人在像这样迅速凝聚共识的时候，可不是以“服从大局”而闻名的。

sentences.en: I think it's because there's a real sense up and down and throughout the party that it's the right thing to do.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是因为在党内从上到下的各个层面，都有这样一种真实的共识：这是正确的事情。

sentences.en: I've actually, I'm not sure I've ever seen us this quickly unify around anything.
sentences.zh: 实际上，我不确定我是否见过我们针对任何事情能这么快地团结起来。

sentences.en: I mean, switching up the ticket has offered Democrats this chance to reset, not just on the person, but on the message and the policies.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，更换候选人给民主党人提供了一个重启的机会，不仅是在人选上，更是在信息和政策上。

sentences.en: President Biden, for example, has taken a lot of heat for his handling of the war on Gaza, inflation, the border.
sentences.zh: 例如，拜登总统因为处理加沙战争、通货膨胀以及边境问题而承受了大量批评。

sentences.en: Would you like to see the Harris campaign differentiating itself on those particular issues?
sentences.zh: 你希望看到哈里斯竞选团队在这些特定问题上展现出与他的差异吗？

sentences.en: Well, I'll leave it to her to indicate where there will be continuity and where she might have a different approach or maybe just a different emphasis.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我会留给她自己去表明哪些地方会保持连贯性，哪些地方她可能会采取不同的方法，或者可能只是侧重点不同。

sentences.en: What would you like to see?
sentences.zh: 你希望看到什么？

sentences.en: Well, I'd like to see her reach those concerns that Americans have.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我希望看到她回应美国人民关切的问题。

sentences.en: So on something like inflation, for example,
sentences.zh: 所以在通货膨胀之类的问题上，比如说，

sentences.en: I think she's well positioned not just to explain how she's contributed to the work that brought inflation back down to 3% in this country,
sentences.zh: 我认为她不仅有很好的优势来解释她如何为将本国通胀率降回3%的工作作出了贡献，

sentences.en: but also the difference between her economic proposals and the clearly inflationary proposals of Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 还能阐明她的经济提案与唐纳德·特朗普明显具有通胀效应的提案之间的区别。

sentences.en: And this is really important because it's actually an example of any of the issues you just mentioned,
sentences.zh: 这真的很重要，因为这实际上是你刚才提到的任何一个问题的缩影，

sentences.en: where even if there is impatience among the American people or the American people don't think we got it perfectly right.
sentences.zh: 即便是美国人民表现出不耐烦，或者美国人民认为我们做得不够完美。

sentences.en: Even on these issues, they disagree with Donald Trump's approach.
sentences.zh: 甚至在这些问题上，他们也不同意唐纳德·特朗普的做法。

sentences.en: What you're saying, I mean, nothing has fundamentally changed about the Democratic message here,
sentences.zh: 你的意思是，民主党在这里传递的信息并没有根本改变，

sentences.en: which is that things are getting better, that inflation has gone down under President Biden.
sentences.zh: 那就是情况正在好转，在拜登总统的领导下通货膨胀已经下降。

sentences.en: I mean, that's been something that the Democratic Party has been trying to run on and push over and over and over again.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是民主党一直试图用来竞选并反复强调的事情。

sentences.en: And yet poll after poll shows that more people trust former President Trump on these issues than President Biden.
sentences.zh: 然而一次又一次的民调显示，更多的人在这些问题上信任前总统特朗普，而不是拜登总统。

sentences.en: Are you suggesting that now because it's a new candidate, Kamala Harris can reset and people will just forget that she was part of the administration?
sentences.zh: 你是在暗示，现在因为换了新候选人，卡玛拉·哈里斯就可以重新开始，而大家就会忘记她曾是本届政府的一员吗？

sentences.en: What I'm saying is that part of what a candidate does, part of what a messenger does, is convince people of things.
sentences.zh: 我所说的是，候选人职责的一部分、发言人职责的一部分，就是说服人们相信某些事情。

sentences.en: And I think she's a very convincing leader.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为她是一位非常有说服力的领导人。

sentences.en: There's been this discussion about how to define Kamala Harris now, right?
sentences.zh: 现在一直有关于如何定义卡玛拉·哈里斯的讨论，对吧？

sentences.en: And so part of what Democrats like yourself and others are trying to do is, you know, show her for who she wants to be as the next president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 所以像你这样的民主党人和其他人努力的一部分，你知道的，就是展现她作为美国下一任总统所希望成为的真实自我。

sentences.en: And the right, meanwhile, is trying to portray Kamala Harris as this far left extension of the failures of the Biden administration.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，右翼正试图将卡玛拉·哈里斯描绘成拜登政府失败的极左延伸。

sentences.en: And they're also using a lot of sexist and racist attacks.
sentences.zh: 他们还在使用许多性别歧视和种族主义的攻击。

sentences.en: They're calling her a DEI hire and worse stuff that I don't want to repeat.
sentences.zh: 他们称她是靠多元化雇佣（DEI）上台的，还有更难听的话我不想重复。

sentences.en: And I just wonder, as a surrogate, how you combat that.
sentences.zh: 我只是想知道，作为一名代言人，你如何回击这些言论？

sentences.en: Well, I do think that those attacks have been a bad look for Republicans.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的确认为这些攻击让共和党人的形象变得非常难看。

sentences.en: And you can tell because when you got somebody like Mike Johnson, who is a very, very conservative figure, right, the Speaker of the House, telling his own caucus, like, hey,
sentences.zh: 你可以看得出来，因为当你有像迈克·约翰逊这样的人，他是一个非常非常保守的人物，对吧，众议院议长，在对自己的党团成员说，嘿，

sentences.en: cool it.
sentences.zh: 收敛一点。

sentences.en: He's basically saying that they are embarrassing the party.
sentences.zh: 他基本上是在说他们在让党丢脸。

sentences.en: And I think acknowledging that they are diminishing the party's chances by indulging in that kind of rhetoric.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，他们承认沉溺于这种言论会削弱党的机会。

sentences.en: And the fact that they can't think of what else to do besides go right to race and gender isn't just revealing about some of the ugliest undercurrents in today's Republican Party.
sentences.zh: 除了直接扯到种族和性别之外想不出别的事要做，这个事实不仅暴露了当今共和党内一些最丑陋的暗流。

sentences.en: It's also just profoundly unimaginative because it means that they can't speak to how any of this is going to make people's lives better.
sentences.zh: 这也显得非常缺乏想象力，因为这意味着他们说不出这一切将如何改善人们的生活。

sentences.en: In other words, certainly not Trump's campaign or Trump's party.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，当然不是特朗普的竞选或特朗普的党派。

sentences.en: They can't conceive a politics that isn't just about the personalities.
sentences.zh: 他们构想不出不只是关于个人魅力的政治。

sentences.en: So everything he does is he beats his chest about his own persona and he tears down his opponent.
sentences.zh: 所以他所做的一切，都是为了标榜自己的个人形象并贬低他的对手。

sentences.en: None of that is about us.
sentences.zh: 这些都与我们无关。

sentences.en: None of it's about you.
sentences.zh: 这些都与你无关。

sentences.en: And that's, again, why their inability to do that, their inability to explain how your life as an American every day will be any different, certainly any better,
sentences.zh: 这也是为什么，他们无法做到这一点，他们无法解释作为美国人的你每一天的生活会有什么不同，尤其是会有什么变好，

sentences.en: is revealed in the fact that they immediately reach for one of two things.
sentences.zh: 这从他们一开口就诉诸两件事的事实中暴露无遗。

sentences.en: It's saying she's too far left, which is what literally every Republican says about literally any Democrat who is running against a Republican.
sentences.zh: 那就是说她太左了，这简直是每一个共和党人在对阵任何民主党候选人时都会说的话。

sentences.en: If Joe Manchin were the nominee, they'd say the same thing about him.
sentences.zh: 如果乔·曼钦是候选人，他们也会对他说同样的话。

sentences.en: It's just standard and therefore boring.
sentences.zh: 这只是标准套路，所以很无聊。

sentences.en: Or these really ugly attacks, which maybe are meant to get attention, but they are very much telling on themselves when they go there.
sentences.zh: 或者那些非常丑陋的攻击，也许是为了博取关注，但当他们这么做时，恰恰暴露了他们自己。

sentences.en: Okay, Pete, you are clearly one of the party's best communicators.
sentences.zh: 好的，皮特，你显然是党内最出色的沟通者之一。

sentences.en: You can deliver a message.
sentences.zh: 你能传达信息。

sentences.en: You have been very on message while we've been talking.
sentences.zh: 在我们交谈的过程中，你一直紧扣主题。

sentences.en: I am thinking about how you see your role right now, because, you know, while Biden rarely talked to the press, you not only engage with people like me,
sentences.zh: 我在想你现在如何看待自己的角色，因为，你知道，虽然拜登很少接受记者采访，但你不仅与像我这样的人交流，

sentences.en: but you also go to Fox News.
sentences.zh: 你还会去福克斯新闻。

sentences.en: And I am wondering why you do that.
sentences.zh: 我在想你为什么要这么做。

sentences.en: What is it about taking the message there that you find could move the needle?
sentences.zh: 把信息带到那里，究竟有什么能让你觉得可以扭转局面的地方？

sentences.en: Well, the reason I think it's so important to take the message there is because I know that there are so many people who tune in in good faith.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为把信息带到那里之所以如此重要，是因为我知道有很多人是怀着善意收看的。

sentences.en: I don't always feel that the corporation that runs Fox News is acting in good faith.
sentences.zh: 我并不总是觉得运营福克斯新闻的公司是在怀着善意行事。

sentences.en: But I know that the viewers, because they're people I know, I mean, my neighbors in Michigan, might be tuning in in good faith and getting their information from this news source.
sentences.zh: 但我知道观众们，因为他们是我认识的人，我是说，我在密歇根州的邻居，可能会怀着善意收看，并从这个新闻来源获取信息。

sentences.en: So I, as a political figure, can hardly blame a voter for not being responsive to our message if they literally have never heard it.
sentences.zh: 因此，作为一个政治人物，如果选民们压根没听过我们的信息，我几乎不能责怪他们对我们的信息没有反应。

sentences.en: And we're in a very fragmented environment.
sentences.zh: 而且我们身处一个高度碎片化的环境中。

sentences.en: Honestly, we're lucky if we can get to somebody through TV versus just even more fragmented Internet sources.
sentences.zh: 说实话，如果我们能通过电视接触到某个人，而不是通过更加碎片化的互联网渠道，我们就已经很幸运了。

sentences.en: And I know that if I'm on that network, I'm one of relatively few voices with our message.
sentences.zh: 我知道，如果我出现在那个网络上，我是为数不多发出我们声音的人之一。

sentences.en: And so if I didn't go there to give that message, somebody might literally never hear it.
sentences.zh: 所以如果我不去那里传递这个信息，有些人可能真的永远也听不到。

sentences.en: I also know that you cannot assume who somebody is or how they're going to vote just based on what network they watch.
sentences.zh: 我也知道，你不能仅仅根据人们看什么电视台，就去揣测他们是谁或他们将如何投票。

sentences.en: Of course, there's a lot of strong patterns, but there's a lot of people who who can be moved.
sentences.zh: 当然，有很多明显的规律，但也有很多人是可以被争取的。

sentences.en: And sometimes the person who picked the channel is not the same as the other person who's also in the house who's listening to what's being said.
sentences.zh: 有时选频道的人和家里另一个正在听节目内容的人并不是同一个。

sentences.en: And so I think there's a responsibility to take this message into those spaces.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，我们有责任把这些信息带到这些地方。

sentences.en: Just as, you know, when I was running for president, I did it geographically, too.
sentences.zh: 正如，你知道的，当我竞选总统时，我也是按地理位置这样做的。

sentences.en: And in Iowa, really kind of specialized in counties that had voted for Barack Obama, but then had turned around and voted for Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 在艾奥瓦州，我主要深耕那些曾投票给贝拉克·奥巴马，后来又转而投票给唐纳德·特朗普的县。

sentences.en: And those counties were ones where I did well in because they were ready to listen.
sentences.zh: 那些县是我表现不错的地方，因为他们愿意倾听。

sentences.en: Because they suddenly became more progressive or because I pretended to be a full-throated conservative.
sentences.zh: 是因为他们突然变得更进步了，还是因为我假装自己是一个坚定的保守派？

sentences.en: Which is because sometimes when you explain what you believe to somebody, even if they don't completely agree with you, they respect you more.
sentences.zh: 这是因为有时当你向某人解释你的信念时，即使他们不完全同意你的看法，他们也会更尊重你。

sentences.en: And are inclined to maybe trust you and give you the benefit of the doubt.
sentences.zh: 并且倾向于信任你，给你一些信任和宽容。

sentences.en: So that's why I'm there.
sentences.zh: 这就是我为什么要去那里的原因。

sentences.en: Do you think the vice president should go on Fox?
sentences.zh: 你认为副总统应该上福克斯吗？

sentences.en: Do you think she should debate on Fox?
sentences.zh: 你认为她应该在福克斯参加辩论吗？

sentences.en: I would be skeptical of the fairness of a debate hosted by Fox, but that's a decision that I'm sure she and the campaign will think through.
sentences.zh: 我对由福克斯主办的辩论的公正性持怀疑态度，但我确信她和竞选团队会仔细权衡这个决定。

sentences.en: I do want to ask you about a specific shift in messaging I've noticed this week from the Democrats.
sentences.zh: 我确实想问你关于本周我注意到民主党在信息传递上的一个具体转变。

sentences.en: The Harris campaign is leaning into the idea that Trump is, quote, weird.
sentences.zh: 哈里斯的竞选团队正在倾向于这样一种观点，即特朗普，引用原话，是个“怪人”。

sentences.en: I've seen this weird word floating around.
sentences.zh: 我看到这个“怪”字到处流传。

sentences.en: It's very different from the way Democrats had framed him before, which is that he's an existential threat to democracy,
sentences.zh: 这与民主党人以前对他的定性非常不同，他们以前认为他是对民主的生存威胁，

sentences.en: this terrifying figure that is going to take away people's rights.
sentences.zh: 是一个会剥夺人们权利的可怕人物。

sentences.en: Weird seems a different tact than that.
sentences.zh: “怪”似乎是一种不同的策略。

sentences.en: What do you think of that strategy of basically laughing at him?
sentences.zh: 你如何看待这种基本上是在嘲笑他的策略？

sentences.en: Well, to be clear, I think we're doing both.
sentences.zh: 嗯，坦白说，我认为我们两手都在抓。

sentences.en: We're talking about the implications for democracy and noting that he is obviously a strange person who's getting stranger.
sentences.zh: 我们既在讨论对民主的影响，也指出他显然是一个怪异的人，而且越来越怪异。

sentences.en: I mean, I think one of the things that especially now that we have a generational difference between Kamala Harris and Donald Trump, who's a generation older,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为其中一点，尤其是现在卡玛拉·哈里斯和比她大一辈的唐纳德·特朗普之间存在代沟，

sentences.en: is that we're watching his trajectory.
sentences.zh: 就是我们正在看着他的轨迹变化。

sentences.en: Not that he was ever the most disciplined and straightforward person, but four years ago,
sentences.zh: 并不是说他以前是个最有纪律、最直率的人，但在四年前，

sentences.en: even I would be still taken aback if he was rambling about electrocuting sharks and all these other things you see him doing that really are weird.
sentences.zh: 即使是我，如果听到他语无伦次地谈论电击鲨鱼以及你在他身上看到的其他那些真正怪异的事情，我仍然会感到大吃一惊。

sentences.en: And you got to ask yourself, you know, is that the kind of person you want in charge of the country, especially because we saw how not just weird, but chaotic it was last time.
sentences.zh: 你不得不问自己，你知道的，这真的是你想让其掌管国家的那种人吗，特别是考虑到我们看到了上一次不仅怪异而且混乱的局面。

sentences.en: And part of the promise of a Kamala Harris presidency is actually the prospect of a comparatively normal Republican Party.
sentences.zh: 卡玛拉·哈里斯担任总统的承诺之一，实际上是带来一个相对正常的共和党的前景。

sentences.en: What I mean by that is, you know, beating Donald Trump the first time in 2020 ended his term, but it did not end his grip on the GOP.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你知道，在2020年第一次击败唐纳德·特朗普结束了他的任期，但这并没有终结他对共和党的控制。

sentences.en: Beating him twice would, I think, have a different effect on a lot of people in the GOP who know better than to be on board with him.
sentences.zh: 击败他两次，我认为会对共和党内许多明知不该与他同流合污的人产生不同的影响。

sentences.en: He goes against their values, too, not just my values, but they've gone along with it because they think it's the path to power.
sentences.zh: 他的所作所为也违背了他们的价值观，不只是我的价值观，但他们一直随波逐流，因为他们认为这是通往权力的道路。

sentences.en: And it would become abundantly clear that that is not true if we beat him, not just the way we beat him in 2020, not just the way we indirectly beat him in 2022 in the midterms,
sentences.zh: 如果我们再次击败他——不仅是以2020年击败他的方式，不仅是以2022年中期选举中我们间接击败他的方式，

sentences.en: but beat him a second or, so to speak, third time.
sentences.zh: 而是击败他第二次，或者可以说是第三次——这一点就会变得极其明朗。

sentences.en: And we will always have fierce and meaningful disagreements between Democrats and Republicans, but there's a chance of that difference, those debates, being a little less ugly or,
sentences.zh: 我们民主党和共和党之间将永远存在激烈而有意义的分歧，但这种分歧、这些辩论有可能会变得不那么丑陋，或者，

sentences.en: to put it another way, a little less weird.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，不那么怪异。

sentences.en: What I'm hearing you say, and please correct me if I'm wrong, is that if Donald Trump is defeated in this election, then perhaps the Republican Party can be freed from his grip?
sentences.zh: 我听到你的意思是——如果我理解错了请纠正我——如果唐纳德·特朗普在这次选举中被击败，那么也许共和党就能从他的掌控中解放出来？

sentences.en: I think so.
sentences.zh: 我想是的。

sentences.en: I think so.
sentences.zh: 我想是的。

sentences.en: Look, I made myself watch the first couple Republican presidential debates, and we still had a lot of Republican candidates this cycle.
sentences.zh: 你看，我特意看了前几场共和党总统初选辩论，这一周期我们仍然有很多共和党候选人。

sentences.en: There were still some things that I thought were pretty fringe, and just about everything I heard I disagreed with, but apart from some of the darkness of Vivek's populism,
sentences.zh: 仍然有一些我认为相当边缘化的观点，我听到的几乎所有内容我都不同意，但除了维韦克民粹主义的一些阴暗面之外，

sentences.en: most of what you saw on there, you could be forgiven for thinking you were looking at a more normal Republican Party,
sentences.zh: 你在上面看到的大多数内容，如果你以为自己看到的是一个更正常的共和党，也是可以被原谅的，

sentences.en: were it not for the fact that the entire thing was an undercard because Donald Trump wasn't there and he was and was and is dominating the party.
sentences.zh: 如果不是因为整个活动只是个垫场赛——因为唐纳德·特朗普不在场，而他过去是、现在也依然主导着这个党派的话。

sentences.en: Look, we have fooled ourselves many times before into thinking that the fever would break.
sentences.zh: 听着，我们以前曾多次自我欺骗，以为这种狂热会消退。

sentences.en: We thought it would happen before he was elected, when the Access Hollywood tape revealed that he had boasted about sexual assault.
sentences.zh: 我们以为在他当选之前就会发生，当时《好莱坞记者》的录音曝光了他吹嘘性侵。

sentences.en: We thought it would happen when he was defeated, but he wasn't in 2016.
sentences.zh: 我们以为他在2016年被击败时会发生，但并没有。

sentences.en: We thought it might happen after January 6th, and it very, very nearly did.
sentences.zh: 我们以为在1月6日之后可能会发生，而且真的非常非常接近发生了。

sentences.en: So many of the people who are now kissing up to him basically turned their back on him then.
sentences.zh: 现在那么多对极力讨好他的人，当时基本上都背叛了他。

sentences.en: We got so close to the fever breaking, but it didn't quite break because Republicans found that their access to power still depended on their standing with Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 我们离狂热消退只有一步之遥，但它并没有完全消退，因为共和党人发现他们对权力的获取仍然取决于他们在唐纳德·特朗普那里的地位。

sentences.en: If he leads this party to defeat a third time after his defeat in 2020 and his party's defeat in 2022, I believe that the self-interest,
sentences.zh: 如果在2020年失利以及他的党派在2022年失利之后，他再次带领这个党走向失败，我相信这种私利，

sentences.en: just the internal power dynamics of the GOP, the very power dynamics that have kept them enthralled to him, even though so many of them know better.
sentences.zh: 也就是共和党内部的权力动态——正是这种权力动态让他们对甘愿受他奴役，尽管他们中许多人心里明镜似的。

sentences.en: Notably, including, by the way, J.D.
sentences.zh: 值得一提的是，顺便说一句，其中就包括JD·

sentences.en: Vance, who back when he was speaking truthfully and for himself, referred to Donald Trump as an idiot and compared him to an opioid,
sentences.zh: 万斯，他在当年还能说真话、为自己发声的时候，曾把唐纳德·特朗普称为白痴，并把他比作阿片类药物，

sentences.en: which is an exceptionally dark thing to say about somebody if you are from or connected to Appalachia as J.D.
sentences.zh: 如果你来自阿巴拉契亚或者与该地区有渊源（就像JD·万斯那样），

sentences.en: Vance is, right?
sentences.zh: 说出这样的话对某人来说是非常恶毒的，对吧？

sentences.en: And that was in public, in private, comparing him to Hitler, and now turning around and supporting him.
sentences.zh: 那是公开说的，私下里，他把他比作希特勒，而现在却转过头来支持他。

sentences.en: But my point is, all of that finally breaks loose if they realize that attaching yourself to Donald Trump doesn't just destroy your character, it destroys your access to power.
sentences.zh: 但我的重点是，如果他们意识到依附于唐纳德·特朗普不仅会毁掉你的人格，还会毁掉你获取权力的途径，所有这一切最终都会瓦解。

sentences.en: You know, you've talked about this fever breaking that you have an appetite for, but we just had an assassination attempt against former President Trump,
sentences.zh: 你知道，你一直在谈论这种你渴望能够消退的狂热，但前总统特朗普刚刚遭遇了一次暗杀未遂，

sentences.en: and he got off off the floor, and he raised his fist in the air with the American flag waving in the background, and he said, fight, fight, fight.
sentences.zh: 他从地上站起来，高举拳头，背景中飘扬着美国国旗，他说，战斗，战斗，战斗。

sentences.en: And his popularity now, in more recent polls, has gone up.
sentences.zh: 现在他在最新民调中的支持率上升了。

sentences.en: People see him as someone who takes his licks and keeps on ticking, and that speaks to, for some people,
sentences.zh: 人们视他为那种经受打击却依然挺立的人，对于某些人来说，这代表了

sentences.en: real fundamental American values about being tough and not caving into intimidation.
sentences.zh: 关于坚韧不拔、不向恐吓低头的真正核心美国价值观。

sentences.en: And so, I'm just wondering if you think that a moment like that, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以，我只是想知道你是否认为这样的时刻，

sentences.en: really breaks through to people and makes him seem fundamentally different than the way that you're describing him, which is weird and aging and vindictive, etc.
sentences.zh: 真的能打动人们，让他显得从根本上不同于你所描述的那样——怪异、老迈且好斗等等。

sentences.en: Well, I think lots of things can be true at the same time.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为很多事情可以同时成立。

sentences.en: That was an extraordinary image, and it is true that he was injured in an attempt on his life, and he got right back up.
sentences.zh: 那是一个非凡的画面，而且千真万确，他在一次谋杀未遂中受伤了，但他立刻就站了起来。

sentences.en: And that's why that image is so powerful.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么那个画面如此具有冲击力。

sentences.en: But it doesn't change the fact that he has shown himself to be vindictive and backward-looking and more interested in his past than in our future.
sentences.zh: 但这并不能改变这样一个事实：他已经表现出自己是一个好斗、开倒车、对我们的未来不感兴趣而只对自己的过去感兴趣的人。

sentences.en: And I would add, there was a moment in the wake of that horrifying moment.
sentences.zh: 我要补充的是，在那个可怕的时刻之后，曾有过这样一个时刻。

sentences.en: There was a sense that he would follow that up by taking the stage at the RNC in Milwaukee and demonstrating his capacity to help bring this country together.
sentences.zh: 人们曾有一种感觉，他会顺势在密尔沃基的RNC（共和党全国代表大会）上登台，展示他有能力帮助这个国家团结起来。

sentences.en: And for a few minutes, he stuck to the script, and it looked like that was going to happen.
sentences.zh: 有那么几分钟，他照着稿子念了，看起来事情确实会朝着那个方向发展。

sentences.en: And then the next hour and a half happened.
sentences.zh: 然后，接下来一个半小时发生了。

sentences.en: And it was as backward-looking and rage-filled and self-obsessed as anything he would have been saying one year or three years or five years ago.
sentences.zh: 那充斥着开倒车、满腔怒火和自我痴迷，跟他一年、三年或五年前说过的任何话一模一样。

sentences.en: More with Pete Buttigieg after the break.
sentences.zh: 广告之后，我们将继续与皮特·布蒂吉格对话。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你刚才听到的人这样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问nytimes.com斜杠games，今天就开始游戏。

sentences.en: You mentioned J.D.
sentences.zh: 你提到了JD·

sentences.en: Vance, and I do want to also ask you about him.
sentences.zh: 万斯，我也确实想问问你关于他的事。

sentences.en: Even though your politics are very far apart, you do share a lot on paper.
sentences.zh: 尽管你们的政治立场相去甚远，但纸面上你们确实有很多相似之处。

sentences.en: You're both Midwesterners.
sentences.zh: 你们都是中西部人。

sentences.en: You both served in the military.
sentences.zh: 你们都曾在军队服役。

sentences.en: You ended up in elite places for school.
sentences.zh: 你们都曾就读于顶尖名校。

sentences.en: And then you spent time in the business world before becoming politicians.
sentences.zh: 在从政之前，你们都在商业领域工作过。

sentences.en: Does that give you any special perspective on him as a person?
sentences.zh: 这有没有让你对他的为人有任何独特的看法？

sentences.en: Well, I've certainly encountered a lot of people like him.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我确实遇到过很多像他这样的人。

sentences.en: And I think he and I both or each emerged at a time when a lot of people in the Midwest began to find that commentators and figures from the coasts were kind of approaching our part of the country.
sentences.zh: 我认为我和他都在这样一个时期崭露头角：当时中西部许多人开始发现，来自沿海地区的评论员和人物开始接近我们这个地区。

sentences.en: Almost like we were these kind of, almost with exotic fascination.
sentences.zh: 几乎就像我们是某种——几乎带着一种猎奇的迷恋。

sentences.en: And at least in my case, I sought to engage that attention as a way to bring support to the city that I was leading as mayor, that I was trying to inspire people to believe in.
sentences.zh: 至少在我的例子中，我寻求吸引这种关注，以此为我作为市长所领导的城市争取支持，去激发人们对这座城市的信念。

sentences.en: Because there's actually a lot of creativity and innovation.
sentences.zh: 因为那里实际上有很多创造力和创新。

sentences.en: I think in a different way, he chased that same vibe.
sentences.zh: 我认为用一种不同的方式，他也追求了那种氛围。

sentences.en: It seems to have led him to Silicon Valley.
sentences.zh: 这似乎把他带到了硅谷。

sentences.en: But then it led him to this place where he's advancing a vision that is terrible for places like where I come from, and I would argue where he comes from.
sentences.zh: 但随后这把他带到了这样一个境地：他正在推行一种对像我出身的地方——我也敢说对像他出身的地方——极其糟糕的愿景。

sentences.en: But the other thing I would say is, you know, he has traded on fascination about Midwestern stories and Midwestern values.
sentences.zh: 但我还要说的是，你知道，他一直靠消费人们对中西部故事和中西部价值观的迷恋来谋利。

sentences.en: But the most important Midwestern value I know of is to be straightforward, to be true to yourself, to be true to your core.
sentences.zh: 但我所知道的最重要的中西部价值观就是坦率真诚，忠于自我，忠于核心。

sentences.en: And because he spoke unequivocally about how sinister and unfit Donald Trump was just a few years ago, only to flip around, embrace him,
sentences.zh: 由于就在几年前，他还曾毫不含糊地指出唐纳德·特朗普是多么险恶、多么不配，结果却转过头来拥抱他，

sentences.en: and be on his ticket so that he can have more power.
sentences.zh: 并加入他的竞选搭档行列以便获取更多权力，

sentences.en: People are wondering if he has any core at all.
sentences.zh: 人们不禁怀疑他是否还有任何核心原则可言。

sentences.en: Have you read Hillbilly Elegy?
sentences.zh: 你读过《乡下人的悲歌》吗？

sentences.en: It's one of those books that I own but haven't read.
sentences.zh: 那是那种我买过但还没读过的书。

sentences.en: Just to be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 老实说。

sentences.en: I've dipped into it.
sentences.zh: 我随便翻过。

sentences.en: I haven't read it cover to cover.
sentences.zh: 我没有从头到尾读过。

sentences.en: Speaking of vice presidents, the next big decision, of course, for Harris is who her own VP is going to be.
sentences.zh: 说到副总统，对哈里斯来说，下一个重大决定当然是她的副总统人选将是谁。

sentences.en: And in a recent NPR-PBS Marist poll, I'm sure you know this, you are tied with Michigan Governor Gretchen Whitmer as the most popular person for the VP pick.
sentences.zh: 在最近的一项NPR-PBS马里斯特民调中，我相信你知道这一点，你与密歇根州长格雷琴·惠特默并列为最受欢迎的副总统人选。

sentences.en: I know you're not going to tell me if you want the job or not, but do you think you'd be a good vice president?
sentences.zh: 我知道你不会告诉我你是否想要这份工作，但你认为你会成为一个好副总统吗？

sentences.en: I don't think it's appropriate for me to talk like that, knowing that the person who needs to make that decision is the person who's going to make it, and that's her, not me.
sentences.zh: 我认为由我来这样谈论并不合适，因为做出这个决定的人必须是那个有权做决定的人，那是她，而不是我。

sentences.en: What I will say is I'm going to do everything I can to help her become the next president.
sentences.zh: 我要说的是，我将竭尽所能帮助她成为下一任总统。

sentences.en: Would you like to be vice president?
sentences.zh: 你想当副总统吗？

sentences.en: Again, I don't think it's appropriate for me to wander down that path with you right now.
sentences.zh: 再次重申，我认为现在跟你探讨这个方向并不合适。

sentences.en: What would it mean, though, to have an openly gay vice president?
sentences.zh: 然而，拥有一位公开的同性恋副总统意味着什么？

sentences.en: I think just as it does in the job I'm in now, just as it did as mayor or to run for president, as someone who's openly gay,
sentences.zh: 我认为，就像在我现在的工作中一样，就像在我担任市长或竞选总统时一样，作为一个公开的同性恋者，

sentences.en: it means that what used to be an indomitable barrier isn't anymore.
sentences.zh: 这意味着曾经不可逾越的障碍不再是障碍了。

sentences.en: As recently as 10 years ago,
sentences.zh: 就在10年前，

sentences.en: I think any knowledgeable person would have said that the idea of an openly gay person pursuing a presidential campaign and getting anywhere was not just uphill,
sentences.zh: 我想任何懂行的人都会说，一个公开的同性恋者发起总统竞选并取得任何进展的想法，不仅是逆水行舟，

sentences.en: it was preposterous.
sentences.zh: 简直是荒谬绝伦。

sentences.en: It was 15 years ago when I took the oath of commission to join the military, it wasn't just some unfortunate prejudicial norm,
sentences.zh: 就在15年前我宣誓加入军队时，这不仅仅是一个不幸的带有偏见的社会常规，

sentences.en: it was the law of this country that I would be fired for being gay.
sentences.zh: 这是这个国家的法律，我会因为我是同性恋而被解雇。

sentences.en: That's changed, and like anybody who is a first, I'm mindful of what that means, and I try to live up to what that might mean to others.
sentences.zh: 这一切都变了，就像任何开创先河的人一样，我铭记这意味着什么，我努力不辜负这对其他人可能意味着的意义。

sentences.en: It's not why I'm doing this work, but it's one more reason to take it seriously.
sentences.zh: 这不是我做这项工作的原因，但这是我认真对待它的又一个理由。

sentences.en: Whoever the VP is, you know, identity is going to play a huge part in the race.
sentences.zh: 不管副总统是谁，你知道的，身份认同将在这次竞选中扮演极其重要的角色。

sentences.en: Harris would be the first woman of color to lead a major party ticket.
sentences.zh: 哈里斯将成为第一位领导主要政党竞选搭档的有色人种女性。

sentences.en: And I will say that, you know, many of the black and brown women friends that I have, have said to me, you know what, there's no way that you'll be elected.
sentences.zh: 而且我想说，你知道的，我的许多黑人和棕色人种女性朋友曾对我说，你知道吗，你根本不可能当选。

sentences.en: There's like a fatalism there, a cynicism about just how far we've actually come as a country.
sentences.zh: 那里有一种宿命论，一种对于我们国家究竟前进了多远的悲观态度。

sentences.en: What would you say about that?
sentences.zh: 你对此有什么看法？

sentences.en: I completely get where that comes from, and yet, even in my short career and life, I have seen these impossibilities turn into realities.
sentences.zh: 我完全理解这种说法的由来，然而，即使在我短暂的职业生涯和人生中，我也见过这些不可能变成现实。

sentences.en: Things that were, again, not just unlikely, but would have been considered ridiculous, have become the norm again and again and again.
sentences.zh: 那些曾经不仅仅是不大可能、甚至会被认为是荒谬的事情，一次又一次地变成了常态。

sentences.en: And not the easy way, I mean, through struggle and persistence.
sentences.zh: 而且过程并不轻松，我是指，那是通过奋斗和坚持得来的。

sentences.en: These things can happen, but if that isn't true, then why does she have to choose a white guy as a VP?
sentences.zh: 这些事情是可能发生的，但如果这不是真的，那她为什么必须选择一个白人男性当副总统呢？

sentences.en: I mean, that's who's being vetted.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这才是正在接受审查的人。

sentences.en: Look, she's going to choose.
sentences.zh: 听着，她会做出选择的。

sentences.en: Nobody knows more, other than maybe Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 除了乔·拜登，没有人比他更清楚了。

sentences.en: Nobody knows more about the vice presidency than she does.
sentences.zh: 没有人比她更了解副总统这个职位。

sentences.en: Nobody knows more about the job of running mate than she does.
sentences.zh: 没有人比她更了解竞选搭档这项工作。

sentences.en: That's not the question.
sentences.zh: 问题不在这里。

sentences.en: The question is about why does she choose.
sentences.zh: 问题在于她为什么要这样选择。

sentences.en: If it isn't true that there is a concern.
sentences.zh: 如果这种担忧根本不存在的话。

sentences.en: But this is what my answer, what I'm saying is, for very good reasons.
sentences.zh: 但这就是我的回答，我想说的是，这是出于非常充分的理由。

sentences.en: She knows what she's doing.
sentences.zh: 她知道自己在做什么。

sentences.en: She knows the job.
sentences.zh: 她了解这项工作。

sentences.en: She knows what she wants.
sentences.zh: 她清楚自己想要什么。

sentences.en: And she knows the people out there who she's going to want to consider.
sentences.zh: 而且她知道外面有哪些人是她想要考虑的。

sentences.en: But again, the other thing I would say, and certainly about her future presidency, which will be historic, is that before something like that happens,
sentences.zh: 但话又说回来，我要说的另一件事，当然也是关于她未来注定会被载入史册的总统任期，那就是在类似的事情发生之前，

sentences.en: people always think it's impossible.
sentences.zh: 人们总是认为这不可能。

sentences.en: So many people thought that in 2008.
sentences.zh: 在2008年时，有太多人这么想了。

sentences.en: Anybody who is going to be a first has to overcome that skepticism.
sentences.zh: 任何想要成为“第一”的人都必须克服这种怀疑。

sentences.en: Last question.
sentences.zh: 最后一个问题。

sentences.en: I assume at this point you know Kamala Harris very well.
sentences.zh: 我想你现在对卡玛拉·哈里斯已经非常了解了。

sentences.en: Do you have any specific story about working with her, something about her as a person that you think voters should know?
sentences.zh: 你有什么关于和她共事的具体故事吗，比如关于她作为一个人的特质，你觉得选民们应该知道的？

sentences.en: I think people do know this, but she is not just impressive.
sentences.zh: 我想人们其实也了解这一点，但她不仅仅是令人印象深刻。

sentences.en: She's smart and funny.
sentences.zh: 她聪明又幽默。

sentences.en: And the best chances I had to see this were when I was very involved in debate prep.
sentences.zh: 我最深切体会到这一点的机会，是我深度参与辩论筹备工作的时候。

sentences.en: I was asked to effectively play Mike Pence, which is a very strange psychological thing for me to do.
sentences.zh: 我被要求实际上扮演迈克·彭斯，对我来说这是一种非常奇妙的心理体验。

sentences.en: But I'm so glad I got to do it because I got to see her in action.
sentences.zh: 但我很高兴我能参与其中，因为我有机会看到她大显身手。

sentences.en: And what I love is that that is coming through.
sentences.zh: 而我最喜欢的是，这一点现在正展现出来。

sentences.en: You know, so often you hear about politicians.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你经常听到关于政客的评价。

sentences.en: I really, it is true sometimes.
sentences.zh: 我真的很认同，有时候确实如此。

sentences.en: I say, oh, this person's like really funny and loose, but it just doesn't come through on TV.
sentences.zh: 我会说，哦，这个人其实非常风趣幽默、随性，但它在电视上就是没表现出来。

sentences.en: Or, you know, this person's smarter than you would think just watching on TV.
sentences.zh: 或者说，你知道的，这个人比你看电视时想象的要聪明。

sentences.en: But I actually think what's interesting, not just TV, but the internet has picked up on the fact that she has this great sense of humor.
sentences.zh: 但我实际上认为有趣的是，不仅是电视，互联网也捕捉到了她有着极好的幽默感这一点。

sentences.en: And I think it's, by the way, also revealing that the GOP has tried to attack her for it and that's fallen flat.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，这也很有启示意义，共和党曾试图因此攻击她，但结果却反响平平。

sentences.en: I mean, even just this idea of, you know, sending around images of her laughing as if her joy is something that, you know, looks bad.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，甚至就拿这种事来说，你知道的，到处散播她大笑的照片，好像她的快乐是什么，你知道的，看起来很不好的事情一样。

sentences.en: When actually what looks bad is to be the doom and death march Republican Party against a Democratic Party that, on one hand,
sentences.zh: 而实际上看起来很不好的，却是那个充满末日和死亡行军色彩的共和党，去对抗这样一个民主党：一方面，

sentences.en: is very clear eyed about the enormous stakes of this election.
sentences.zh: 他们对这次选举的巨大赌注有着非常清醒的认识。

sentences.en: And on the other hand, is visibly enjoying ourselves right now.
sentences.zh: 而另一方面，他们现在也明显乐在其中。

sentences.en: Pete Buttigieg, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 皮特·布蒂吉格，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Appreciate your time.
sentences.zh: 感谢你的时间。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Covered a lot of ground there.
sentences.zh: 我们今天聊了很多内容。

sentences.en: We did.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: I appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: That's Pete Buttigieg.
sentences.zh: 这位是皮特·布蒂吉格。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种对光线极度敏感、需要完全黑暗才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会不会为了睡觉而喝断片。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们睡觉时需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这真的是一件很具体的事。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症吗，有饮食禁忌吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们习惯喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？
